# FlinT OS — application component (firmware logic for FlinT devices)

get_filename_component(FLINT_COMPONENT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}" ABSOLUTE)

# device.cmake is generated by tools/select_device.py (root CMakeLists).
include("${FLINT_COMPONENT_DIR}/board/device.cmake")
if(DEFINED IDF_TARGET AND NOT "${FLINT_DEVICE_IDF_TARGET}" STREQUAL "${IDF_TARGET}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "FLINT_DEVICE '${FLINT_DEVICE_ID}' expects idf_target=${FLINT_DEVICE_IDF_TARGET}, "
        "but IDF_TARGET=${IDF_TARGET}. Run: idf.py set-target ${FLINT_DEVICE_IDF_TARGET}")
endif()
message(STATUS "FlinT OS board ${FLINT_DEVICE_ID} (${FLINT_DEVICE_DISPLAY_ID}, bus=${FLINT_DEVICE_DISPLAY_BUS})")

# Explicit SRCS (not SRC_DIRS glob): new .c/.cpp must be listed here so CMake
# reconfigures on the next build instead of silently omitting the object.
set(FLINT_SRCS
    render/watch_display.cpp
    render/fonts.cpp
    storage/fs_io.cpp
    storage/package_storage.cpp
    companion/ignit_runtime.cpp
    companion/ignits.cpp
    faces/face_ignit.cpp
    companion/control.cpp
    anim/anim.cpp
    ble/ble_link.cpp
    app/app.cpp
    assets/asset_store.cpp
    day_mode/day_mode.cpp
    day_mode/day_mode_hour.cpp
    day_mode/day_mode_profile.cpp
    display/display.cpp
    display/resources.cpp
    display/fonts_smooth.cpp
    event/event.cpp
    faces/FaceRegistry.cpp
    faces/face_digital.cpp
    faces/faces_builtin.cpp
    faces/glance.cpp
    i18n/i18n.cpp
    usb/pc_link.cpp
    settings/cfg_fs.cpp
    settings/settings.cpp
    shell/shell.cpp
    shell/shell_picker.cpp
    shell/shell_settings.cpp
    time/clock_time.cpp
    time/date_fmt.cpp
    time/tz_db.cpp
    ui/chrome.cpp
    ui/splash.cpp
    ui/ui.cpp
    ui/ui_dirty.cpp
)

idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${FLINT_SRCS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "."
    REQUIRES
        bt
        esp_partition
        nvs_flash
        esp_timer
        esp_driver_gpio
        freertos
        heap
        log
        esp_driver_usb_serial_jtag
        LovyanGFX
        joltwallet__littlefs
)
